item.title: Cyber & AI Daily Briefing — August 19, 2026
item.description: A forged-JWT SharePoint bypass, a Fortune-500 Azure/Entra credential-theft spree, and an emergency GitLab patch all trace back to the same root cause: identity, not malware. Plus OpenAI pauses Astra training after a first-ever "Critical" cyber classification, and Google enters the model-routing race.
